Frequently Asked Questions

Expert guidance on Interior Fit-Out in Abu Dhabi.

Answers to common project and execution questions from our UAE site engineering team.

What is included in NASAQ's interior fit-out service?

NASAQ's interior fit-out service covers the complete physical execution of approved interior plans: material coordination, site execution, wall and ceiling works, and precision finishing.

How do you coordinate with our interior design consultant or architect?

We work directly alongside your architect or interior consultant, attending technical site meetings and strictly honoring specified finishes, materials, and dimensional tolerances.

Do you handle municipality and developer approvals (NOC)?

Yes. We coordinate with building managements and developer technical teams across Abu Dhabi to ensure compliance with permit criteria and work hour limitations.
